language_rules.register: Formal, clear, and evidence-based British/Irish English (e.g. programme, organise).
principles: Keep every claim consistent with your visa file, offer letter, transcripts, CV, and financial documents.
Do not overstate reasons for choosing Ireland.
Do not add facts that cannot be supported.
Keep the document tailored to the exact institution and program.

banned_phrases: I want to settle in Ireland permanently
Any university in Ireland is fine
This is only for visa approval
I have no specific academic reason
My sponsor will definitely cover everything without proof
at the end of the day

preferred_replacements.I want PR: I plan to use this qualification to develop my career after graduation.
preferred_replacements.any university is fine: This program best matches my academic interests.
